snippet.title: CENTAVO | Official Announcement Trailer | City sim where every cent is traceable
snippet.description:
A city sim where money never comes from nowhere. You lay the streets and zone; residents buy the lots, open businesses, hire and leave if work or food runs out. Click any payment and see whose pocket it came from. Grow a camp into a metropolis.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5295180/CENTAVO/
Discord: https://discord.gg/bPWjacy7Gg

Made by a solo developer in Brazil. Early Access in 2027.
